integrity: The proof starts from the exact published band inequality, controls the lower-order discrepancy in density, and evaluates the remaining periodic sign correlation analytically. The bundled computation is only a finite replay and is not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The result is for the exactly collapsed connecting edge, not a small positive connecting length.
Only the limiting spectral-energy density is identified; no optimal finite-cutoff remainder is claimed.
The originality search cannot exclude an equivalent observation under unrelated terminology.
title: Parity anomaly in the commensurate spectral density of a tightly connected ring chain
